answer: I gate each mining slot with a bonded enclave pulse: a miner posts 500 tokens and burns 40 kWh of attested compute, then a unique secure-enclave key signs a heartbeat every 10 minutes. Duplicate keys collapse into one mirror identity, so a Sybil farm of 1,000 fake nodes needs 1,000 physical enclaves at $60 each, 500,000 tokens locked for 90 days, and 40 MWh of metered power. Add $18k monthly colocation rent, $60k in silicon, and 300 hours of provisioning per rack. That fable is the whole defense: identity costs hardware, plus 12 hours per replacement HSM.
